methods.title: Materialize loop results in an array before JSON serialization.
methods.failure_signature: The first required-skill inventory probe piped a foreach statement directly into JSON and PowerShell rejected the empty pipe before reading skills.
trigger_preconditions: A bounded startup metadata or source-validation operation is required.
methods.candidate_workaround: Materialize loop results in an array before JSON serialization.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never pipe a PowerShell foreach statement directly; assign its results first.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failure, and leave source, sibling, shared, global, and route state unchanged.

methods.title: Materialize the reference rows before projection and retain the repeated failure separately.
methods.failure_signature: A later reference-metadata probe repeated the same direct foreach-to-pipeline parser failure.
trigger_preconditions: A bounded startup metadata or source-validation operation is required.
methods.candidate_workaround: Materialize the reference rows before projection and retain the repeated failure separately.
methods.recurrence_guard: Apply the recorded loop-materialization guard to every later metadata projection.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failure, and leave source, sibling, shared, global, and route state unchanged.

methods.title: Correct only the two declaration separators and rerun the source syntax check before plan generation.
methods.failure_signature: The first planning-source syntax check found malformed const declaration separators in the duplicate-fault and partition-fault fixture definitions.
trigger_preconditions: A bounded startup metadata or source-validation operation is required.
methods.candidate_workaround: Correct only the two declaration separators and rerun the source syntax check before plan generation.
methods.recurrence_guard: Run the explicit CommonJS stdin syntax check before invoking any Node text entrypoint.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failure, and leave source, sibling, shared, global, and route state unchanged.

methods.title: Correct only the delay-map initializer and rerun the source syntax check before plan generation.
methods.failure_signature: The second planning-source syntax check isolated one remaining malformed const initializer in the delay-fault fixture definition.
trigger_preconditions: A bounded startup metadata or source-validation operation is required.
methods.candidate_workaround: Correct only the delay-map initializer and rerun the source syntax check before plan generation.
methods.recurrence_guard: Inspect every multi-variable const declaration after the first syntax failure rather than assuming all sibling declarations were covered.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failure, and leave source, sibling, shared, global, and route state unchanged.

methods.title: Make each retry-budget fixture a distinct finite case by binding an explicit case ID and monotonic attempt count while preserving the no-execution boundary.
methods.failure_signature: The first plan-generation invocation stopped at the novelty gate because retry-budget cases repeated three semantic definitions across ten requested records.
trigger_preconditions: A bounded startup metadata or source-validation operation is required.
methods.candidate_workaround: Make each retry-budget fixture a distinct finite case by binding an explicit case ID and monotonic attempt count while preserving the no-execution boundary.
methods.recurrence_guard: Preflight per-operation definition cardinality before materialization whenever fixture fields use a modulus or another many-to-one transformation.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failure, and leave source, sibling, shared, global, and route state unchanged.

methods.title: Replace only the generic participant-gap hypothesis with a simulation-specific vacancy contract, compute the full bounded all-pairs score, and enforce the declared threshold before future writes.
methods.failure_signature: The corrected build materialized a 0.857 title-similarity neighbor while its declared semantic threshold was 0.78 because the builder reported but did not enforce that gate.
trigger_preconditions: A bounded startup metadata or source-validation operation is required.
methods.candidate_workaround: Replace only the generic participant-gap hypothesis with a simulation-specific vacancy contract, compute the full bounded all-pairs score, and enforce the declared threshold before future writes.
methods.recurrence_guard: Make every declared novelty threshold an executable pre-write stop rather than report-only metadata.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failure, and leave source, sibling, shared, global, and route state unchanged.

methods.title: Use the bounded Node novelty checker with pre-tokenized set arithmetic and stop relying on nested PowerShell object construction for the 40,000-pair comparison.
methods.failure_signature: A PowerShell all-pairs hypothetical title projection crossed the 30-second response window without yielding its result.
trigger_preconditions: A bounded startup metadata or source-validation operation is required.
methods.candidate_workaround: Use the bounded Node novelty checker with pre-tokenized set arithmetic and stop relying on nested PowerShell object construction for the 40,000-pair comparison.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use the dedicated bounded Node checker for proposal-neighbor scans and keep PowerShell projections scalar or linear.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failure, and leave source, sibling, shared, global, and route state unchanged.

methods.title: Parameterize the source-plan path, preserve only repository-relative paths in committed artifacts, and scan the complete planning surface before staging.
methods.failure_signature: The first retained novelty-repair tool encoded a host-specific absolute source-plan path before planning validation.
trigger_preconditions: A bounded startup metadata or source-validation operation is required.
methods.candidate_workaround: Parameterize the source-plan path, preserve only repository-relative paths in committed artifacts, and scan the complete planning surface before staging.
methods.recurrence_guard: Pass host paths at invocation time and never embed a private absolute route in a committed owner tool or baton.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failure, and leave source, sibling, shared, global, and route state unchanged.

methods.title: Replace only this blank-root worktree's sparse pattern with the Sylven v691-v6 owner root, verify the index remains empty, and repeat exact staging only after the planning manifest is refreshed.
methods.failure_signature: The first exact Git stage matched only paths outside the inherited Elowen sparse-checkout pattern and therefore staged zero Sylven files.
trigger_preconditions: A blank-root owner lane is ready for its first exact stage.
methods.candidate_workaround: Replace only this blank-root worktree's sparse pattern with the Sylven v691-v6 owner root, verify the index remains empty, and repeat exact staging only after the planning manifest is refreshed.
methods.recurrence_guard: Set and read back the new owner sparse pattern immediately after switching an inherited worktree to an orphan branch and before the first Git add.
methods.rollback: Leave the index empty, retain the failed stage, and do not add outside the exact owner root.
